# Linear phase, group delay 31 samples = 62 ms.
# USE WITH the one-pole DC blocker below, applied FIRST:
#   y[n] = x[n] - x[n-1] + 0.995*y[n-1]     (corner 0.40 Hz, ~0 ms delay)
# The DC blocker removes gravity (-0.604 g -> +2.2e-05 g, ~89 dB) at zero
# latency; an FIR cannot do that without ~1 s of group delay.
